The MEMORY this is for me.
I was waiting for the train home from college, just minding my business.

Then this dropped.

I was in shock.
'ANOTHER ONE?!' I thought

It was a moment.
I listened to it, and I loved it immediately (crazy that JACK ANTONOFF worked on this).
Those synths were like entering another dimension.

The bars, what he was saying.
It was sooo fire.

The Toosie Slide bar GAGGED me.
I still remember having my hand over my mouth as the train stopped at Stratford, when people were getting on and off.

When I got home, some reactions were already up.
